content.thinking: Now let's test the native stages against the fixtures.

arguments.command: cd /workspace && for f in atlas pack trace; do echo "=== $f ==="; ./tmp/engine-test < examples/native-$f.in.native > /tmp/out.$f 2>/tmp/err.$f; diff <(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < /tmp/out.$f) <(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < examples/native-$f.out.native) && echo MATCH || { echo DIFF; cat /tmp/err.$f; head -c 400 /tmp/out.$f; echo; head -c 400 examples/native-$f.out.native; }; done
